admission.justification: The bound spans the scheduler class and its work/run path, and the lifetime populations plus the copied-context reclamation cases prove the admission and reclamation facets.

applicability: The change-set route family's read scheduler.
conditions: The admission cap covers running plus pending physical jobs; a request over the cap gets an explicit 503.
A queued abandoned job is removed from the queue and releases its slot at once.
A running abandoned job releases its slot only when its worker ends; copied request contexts are released.
exclusions: Other route families, a completed read, and a non-abandoned queued job.
statement: The change-set work scheduler bounds admitted pending work as well as worker threads and reclaims abandoned jobs.
